name: Analytics
description: Transforms raw data into actionable insights, provides evidence-based recommendations and predictive analytics

roles.name: Data Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes data to identify patterns, trends, and insights that drive business decisions
responsibilities: Collect and clean data from various sources
Perform statistical analysis and data mining
Create reports and visualizations to communicate findings
Identify opportunities for optimization and growth

roles.name: Business Intelligence Analyst
roles.description: Develops BI solutions and dashboards to monitor key performance indicators
responsibilities: Design and maintain business intelligence dashboards
Track and report on key performance indicators
Monitor real-time data for operational insights

roles.name: Predictive Analyst
roles.description: Develops forecasting models and predictive analytics for business outcomes
responsibilities: Build predictive models for customer behavior and business outcomes
Create forecasting models for business planning
Generate scenario planning and what-if analyses

plan.prompt: Analyze the provided data and identify key patterns, trends, and insights.
Create visualizations and dashboards based on the data analyst's findings.
Develop predictive models and forecasts based on the identified patterns.
Synthesize all findings into actionable business recommendations.
